ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 40% high-intensity white regions on the distal lobes and 60% low-intensity black regions concentrated centrally and as dense mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, irregular high-intensity (white) polygons occupy the lateral distal regions; a large, contiguous low-intensity (black) shape occupies the central area and connects to the peduncle region; low-intensity linear streaks and clusters are distributed across the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped depression at the central intersection; internal angle approximately 45-50 degrees with a depth of roughly 1/5th the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude micro-serrations (1-3 pixel amplitude) along the trailing boundary; a prominent macro-scale indentation (approx. 15-20 pixel depth) is located on the right lobe approximately 80% from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to the upper and lower boundaries of the lobes, tapering to blunt points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered across the high-intensity regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of dark, non-parallel linear segments (lengths between 20-100 pixels) intersecting the high-intensity areas, notably on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct triangular defect/missing tissue section on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
